claims.text: As-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 has a coarse lamellar-colony microstructure.
The initial lamellar microstructure comprises ductile L12 and brittle B2 phases.
Internal boundaries in the initial lamellar structure are prone to microcrack initiation.
Hybrid cryogenic and moderate-temperature thermo-mechanical processing will convert the cast structure into an ultrafine duplex structure while retaining its lamellar character.
The proposed processing will produce coherent nanoscale precipitates specifically along phase boundaries.
A total reduction of approximately 90%, followed by processing near 600 °C, can retain the lamellar morphology while avoiding unwanted recrystallization.
The processed structure will have nanometric interlamellar spacing.
Lamellar refinement will enhance dislocation storage.
Enhanced dislocation storage will increase back-stress hardening.
Coherent nanoscale precipitates at phase boundaries will reinforce the interfaces and suppress early microcrack initiation.
The refined hierarchical structure and reinforced interfaces will delay localized plastic instability.
The processed alloy will have a statistically significant increase in room-temperature yield strength relative to the as-cast alloy.
The processed alloy will have a statistically significant increase in room-temperature tensile ductility relative to the as-cast alloy.
The processed alloy will exhibit a higher tensile strain-hardening rate than the as-cast alloy.
The processed alloy will exhibit delayed crack propagation.
The as-cast baseline has poorly strengthened phase boundaries that cause early microcracking and a strength-ductility trade-off.
Excessive heat or strain that destroys the lamellar morphology or causes over-recrystallization may negate the improvement.
The intervention is applicable primarily to EHEAs with eutectic lamellar arrangements similar to AlCoCrFeNi2.1.

contradictions.description: The intervention is described as a single processing step, but it is a multistage sequence of cryogenic rolling followed by annealing or warm rolling.
The conditions state that processing promotes coherent ordering, whereas the structural mediator describes the relevant coherent interfaces or precipitates as chemically disordered.
